name: Closure-set arc knee: hub 3 on a passive trunnion yoke whose tilt changes the J2-J3 arc, set by the radial closure through GH (fold lever, rotations only)
lens: round3:self-alignment / loop closure through cheap rotational passive joints
family: offset axes + closure-set passive orientation DOF
verdict: screened, far behind its own control: best honest 68.59 (score 75.06) on Bench(60,160) fast vs the SAME chain with the knee locked (pin dyad) 31.32; the knee is inert unless J2's line is offset (closed form: with J1 through GH the radial closure is F(q2, psi) = 0, a cam of the elbow), and with an explicit 24-30 mm J2 offset + the flank rule it removes the J2 fold kinematically (kin-ok 0.895, 0 fold vs 47, overhead 0.88) but the offset lifts hub 2 out of band and the knee's in-plane drift (hK sin dpsi, 70-90 mm span) spreads the pin dyad over the curved arm: in-band 0.49-0.58 vs 0.79. Not converged (CMA still gaining); farm CMA streams A-C queued. Not a candidate for score 90.
limiter: in-band 0.49 (hub 2 lifted by the cam offset to ~32 mm, fork ring tilting with link 2, E arm / cuff link / pad swept by 70-90 mm of in-plane drift over the curved arm) and the closure's own fold (no-root poses where the cam demands more radial than the parabola's peak); kinematically the J2 fold is gone
note: Bench(60,160) fast, seed VModel checks (closure < 0.5 mm / 0.5 deg, jam rule, >= 1 mm part clearance, 0.15 mm adjacent), knee tracked at 10 fps from each clip's first frame (jump > 25 deg = not followed), FLANK RULE (only roots on the rest root's side of the closure parabola), conditioning >= 8 mm/rad, trunnion refit into hub 3's housing, pin b >= 20 mm distal; invalid configs score 500+. History: 2 first configs + 256 farm coarse (model v1: no flank rule, no cam; locked control 31.32, best knee 76.84) + 81 local CMA (model v3, earm_over; best k322 68.59). Gate on the v3 CMA stream: NOT converged (+3.39 score pts over the 2nd half, +2.28 over the last third, top-5 spread 2.06). Bounds hit: o2 30 (cap), lE 40 (cap). Frozen Bench(110,360) exact: running on the 77.92 shape when this row was written (.cache/csak/frozen_L.json). R10 conditioning at the CMA bests: authority p50 54-76 mm/rad = 0.8-1.1 deg of knee per mm of radial GH motion (prototype 2-5.7).
